note: Alexey research line for brackets. brackets_02 is the current best at 3,494,864 -- 2.14x better than brackets_00's 7,473,269. Pure geometry: same three machine rooms, trimmed of empty edges and re-placed.

variants.label: brackets_01 with two pipes sharing a gap row
variants.architecture: Identical to brackets_01 except that pipe 2 (classify->close, columns 3-7) and pipe 6 (the long wrap, columns 11-35) occupy disjoint column ranges and therefore share gap row 20, letting everything below shift up one row. 37x41.

variants.label: repacked: rooms stacked classify/close/open, pipes shortened
variants.architecture: Machine rooms used verbatim, only trimmed of provably empty edges (classify 19x20->19x18, close 10x32->9x30, open unchanged), then stacked vertically instead of classify-beside-open. Ports keep their offsets relative to each room, so nearest-pipe resolution inside the rooms is untouched. Room ORDER is what makes the routing planar: with close in the middle, one of the two cross-layout wraps becomes a two-row hop and only one long pipe remains, owning the east columns and the bottom row.
variants.verdict: Superseded by brackets_02 (one more gap row squeezed out).

measuredLimits.deadCells: no fully dead interior row or column remains in any of the three rooms
measuredLimits.whyRoomsCannotShrink: The five comparison blocks in classify each need two rows -- one for the block, one for the mismatch return -- and cannot be serpentined onto one row each. X always routes the MATCH case straight ahead, so a westbound block's match arm runs west while its `s` must reach the OPEN port on the east wall; at low columns that cell resolves to the CLOSE port instead. Routing the arm around to a shared send cell is geometrically possible but roughly doubles the per-character walk (~39 ticks -> ~75), losing more on ticks than it gains on footprint.
measuredLimits.gapRows: all three inter-room gaps are now minimal: 1 row between classify and close (shared), 2 between close and open, 3 below open (port row, wrap run, return run -- the return cannot share because it must cross the wrap's columns)
